title: Count a character in a string
task: The string at text (0x820) ends with a zero byte. Store at count (0x804), as a word, how many of its bytes equal the byte at key (0x800); then end with B . . A key of 0 matches nothing: the zero ends the string. Read the string with LDRB and step an index by 1. To run it in a processor view, choose "Extended datapath" in the instruction-set menu: immediates there are 0 to 255. Keep the .equ lines: the tests write the data at those addresses.
starter:
; count-byte -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, ARMv7)
; Count the bytes of text equal to key.
; Hint: LDRB, CMP with 0 to stop, CMP with the key, ADDEQ.
        .equ  key, 0x800        ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  count, 0x804      ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  text, 0x820       ; the tests write and read here

done:   B     done           ; replace with your code; B . ends the run
